   167	  getter asString(): String = "PlusReduction"
   168	  empty(): Any = 0
   169	  join(a: Any, b: Any): Any = a + b
   170	end
   171	opr SUM(): BigReduction[\Any, Any\] = BigReduction[\Any, Any\](PlusReduction)
   172	(* END FIG *)
   173	
   174	(* FIG backward *)
   175	(* every node after all the nodes it depends on *)
   176	topo(root: Node): List[\Node\] = do
   177	  var seen: Set[\ZZ32\] := {[\ZZ32\] }
   178	  var order: List[\Node\] := <|[\Node\] |>
   179	  visit(n: Node): () =
   180	    if n.id NOTIN seen then
   181	      seen := seen.add(n.id)
   182	      for c <- seq(n.children) do visit(c) end
   183	      order := order.addRight(n)
   184	    end
   185	  visit(root)
   186	  order
   187	end
   188	backward(L: Num): () = do
   189	  L.grad := num(1.0)
   190	  for n <- seq(topo(L).reverse) do n.push() end
   191	end
   192	(* END FIG *)
   193	
   194	(********************************************************************
   195	 * The model
   196	 ********************************************************************)
   197	
   198	epsilon: RR64 = 10.0^(-5)
   199	
   200	(* FIG rmsnorm *)
   201	rmsnorm(x: Vec): Vec = x/(SQRT((x DOT x)/(|x|) + epsilon))
   202	rmsnorm(X: Mat): Mat = stack(<| rmsnorm(x) | x <- X |>)
   203	(* END FIG *)
   204	
   205	(* FIG softmax *)
   206	softmax(z: Vec): Vec = do
   207	  e = exp(z - (BIG MAX[z_i <- z] z_i))
   208	  e/(SUM e)
   209	end
   210	softmax(Z: Mat): Mat = stack(<| softmax(z) | z <- Z |>)
   211	(* END FIG *)
   212	
   213	(* FIG attention *)
   214	(* causal mask: a position attends to itself and the positions before it *)
   215	mask(n: ZZ32): Mat = mat(array[\RR64\](n, n).fill(fn (i, j) => if j > i then -infinity else 0.0 end))
   216	
   217	attend(Q: Mat, K: Mat, V: Mat): Mat = do
   218	  d_k = cols(Q)
   219	  softmax((Q K^T)/(SQRT d_k) + mask(|Q|)) V
   220	end
   221	(* END FIG *)
   222	
   223	(* FIG layer *)
   224	object Layer(n_head: ZZ32, W_q: Mat, W_k: Mat, W_v: Mat, W_o: Mat, W_in: Mat, W_out: Mat)
   225	  attention(X: Mat): Mat = do
   226	    (Q, K, V) = (X W_q^T, X W_k^T, X W_v^T)
   227	    d_h = cols(Q) DIV n_head
   228	    head(h: ZZ32): Mat = do c = (h d_h) # d_h; attend(Q[:, c], K[:, c], V[:, c]) end
   229	    concat(<| head(h) | h <- 0#n_head |>) W_o^T
   230	  end
   231	  mlp(X: Mat): Mat = relu(X W_in^T) W_out^T
   232	  forward(X: Mat): Mat = do
   233	    X' = X + attention(rmsnorm(X))
   234	    X' + mlp(rmsnorm(X'))
   235	  end
   236	  matrices(): List[\Mat\] = <| W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, W_in, W_out |>
   237	end
   238	(* END FIG *)
   239	
   240	(* FIG model *)
   241	object Model(E: Mat, P: Mat, W_lm: Mat, layers: List[\Layer\])
   242	  (* logits for the next token at every position *)
   243	  forward(tokens: List[\ZZ32\]): Mat = do
   244	    var X: Mat := rmsnorm(E[tokens] + P[0 # |tokens|])
   245	    for l <- seq(layers) do X := l.forward(X) end
   246	    X W_lm^T
   247	  end
   248	  matrices(): List[\Mat\] = <| E, P, W_lm |> || (BIG CONCAT[\Mat\][l <- layers] l.matrices())
   249	end
   250	(* END FIG *)
   251	
   252	(* FIG loss *)
   253	(* cross-entropy of the next token, averaged over the positions *)
   254	loss(model: Model, tokens: List[\ZZ32\]): Num = do
   255	  n = |tokens| - 1
   256	  (x, y) = (tokens[0 # n], tokens[1 # n])
   257	  P = softmax(model.forward(x))
   258	  -(1/n) (SUM[t <- 0#n] log P[t, y[t]])
   259	end
   260	(* END FIG *)
   261	
   262	
   263	(********************************************************************
   264	 * Parameters, optimizer, sampling, tokenizer, initialization
   265	 ********************************************************************)
   266	
   267	(* FIG params *)
   268	(* the parameters as Karpathy's state_dict: a name for every matrix; the
   269	   elementwise algebra Adam needs is defined once, over the whole record *)
   270	object Params(m: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\])
   271	  opr [name: String]: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = m[name]
   272	  each(f: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Params = record(fn name => f(m[name]), dom(m))
   273	  zip(o: Params, f: (Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]) -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Params =
   274	    record(fn name => f(m[name], o[name]), dom(m))
   275	end
   276	(* a record from a function of the name, by a fold: the map comprehension
   277	   cannot join matrices of different shapes (probes/c18), and BIG UNION over
   278	   singleton maps collides with Set's BIG UNION in one component (probes/c19) *)
   279	record(f: String -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], keys: Generator[\String\]): Params = do
   280	  var r: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] := {[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] }
   281	  for name <- seq(keys) do r := r.add(name, f(name)) end
   282	  Params(r)
   283	end
   284	opr +(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x + y)
   285	opr -(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x - y)
   286	opr juxtaposition(c: RR64, a: Params): Params = a.each(fn x => x.scale(c))
   287	opr ODOT(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => hadamard(x, y))
   288	opr /(a: Params, c: RR64): Params = a.each(fn x => x.scale(1/c))
   289	opr /(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x.ivmap[\RR64\](fn (ij, e) => e/y.get(ij)))
   290	opr +(a: Params, c: RR64): Params = a.each(fn x => x.map[\RR64\](fn e => e + c))
   291	opr SQRT(a: Params): Params = a.each(fn x => x.map[\RR64\](fn e => SQRT e))
   292	(* END FIG *)
   293	
   294	(* FIG adam *)
   295	object Adam(beta1: RR64, beta2: RR64, epsilon: RR64)
   296	  (* one update of the parameters theta from their gradient g, with the moment
   297	     estimates m and v, at step t with learning rate eta: Kingma & Ba, Algorithm 1 *)
   298	  step(theta: Params, g: Params, m: Params, v: Params, t: ZZ32, eta: RR64): (Params, Params, Params) = do
   299	    m' = beta1 m + (1 - beta1) g
   300	    v' = beta2 v + (1 - beta2) (g ODOT g)
   301	    m_hat = m'/(1 - beta1^t)
   302	    v_hat = v'/(1 - beta2^t)
   303	    (theta - eta m_hat/(SQRT v_hat + epsilon), m', v')
   304	  end
   305	end
   306	(* END FIG *)
   307	
   308	(* FIG build *)
   309	(* the model's nodes for one step, built from the parameter record *)
   310	build(theta: Params, n_head: ZZ32, n_layer: ZZ32): Model = do
   311	  p(name: String): Mat = mat(theta[name])
   312	  layer(l: ZZ32): Layer = do
   313	    w(part: String): Mat = p("layer" l "." part)
   314	    Layer(n_head, w("attn_wq"), w("attn_wk"), w("attn_wv"), w("attn_wo"), w("mlp_fc1"), w("mlp_fc2"))
   315	  end
   316	  Model(p("wte"), p("wpe"), p("lm_head"), <| layer(l) | l <- 0#n_layer |>)
   317	end
   318	(* the names, in the order of Model.matrices() *)
   319	names(n_layer: ZZ32): List[\String\] =
   320	  (<|[\String\] "wte", "wpe", "lm_head" |> ||
   321	   (BIG CONCAT[\String\][l <- 0#n_layer] <|[\String\] "layer" l ".attn_wq", "layer" l ".attn_wk", "layer" l ".attn_wv",
   322	                                                      "layer" l ".attn_wo", "layer" l ".mlp_fc1", "layer" l ".mlp_fc2" |>))
   323	(* the gradient record after backward *)
   324	grads(g: Model, n_layer: ZZ32): Params = do
   325	  var r: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] := {[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] }
   326	  for (i, name) <- seq((names(n_layer)).indexValuePairs) do r := r.add(name, ((g.matrices())[i]).grad.v) end
   327	  Params(r)
   328	end
   329	(* END FIG *)
   330	
   331	(* FIG sample *)
   332	(* inverse-transform sampling with the uniform draw u: the number of prefix sums
   333	   of p that do not exceed u times the total (random.choices normalizes), capped at
   334	   the last index *)
   335	pick(p: Vec, u: RR64): ZZ32 = do
   336	  total = SUM[p_i <- p] p_i
   337	  cumulative(j: ZZ32): RR64 = SUM[i <- 0:j] p[i]
   338	  (|<| j | j <- p.indices, cumulative(j) <= u total |>|) MIN (|p| - 1)
   339	end
   340	(* END FIG *)
   341	
   342	(* FIG tokenizer *)
   343	object Tokenizer(uchars: String)
   344	  bos: ZZ32 = |uchars|
   345	  encode(doc: String): List[\ZZ32\] =
   346	    <|[\ZZ32\] bos |> || <| (if i <- uchars.indexOf(ch) then i else 0 end) | ch <- doc |> || <|[\ZZ32\] bos |>
   347	  decode(t: ZZ32): String = "" || uchars[t]
   348	end
   349	(* END FIG *)
   350	
   351	(* FIG init *)
   352	(* Gaussian initialization (Box-Muller over the library's uniform random) *)
   353	gauss(std: RR64): RR64 = do
   354	  (u1, u2) = (random(1.0) MAX 10.0^(-12), random(1.0))
   355	  std (SQRT(-2 (log u1))) (cos(2 pi u2))
   356	end
   357	init(vocab: ZZ32, d: ZZ32, block: ZZ32, n_layer: ZZ32, std: RR64): Params = do
   358	  shape(name: String): (ZZ32, ZZ32) = case name of
   359	    "wte" => (vocab, d); "wpe" => (block, d); "lm_head" => (vocab, d)
   360	    else => if name.endsWith("mlp_fc1") then (4 d, d) elif name.endsWith("mlp_fc2") then (d, 4 d) else (d, d) end
   361	  end
   362	  record(fn name => do (n, m) = shape(name); array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(fn (i, j) => gauss(std)) end, names(n_layer))
   363	end
   364	(* END FIG *)
   365	
   366	(* TESTS *)
   367	randomMat(n: ZZ32, m: ZZ32, std: RR64): Mat = mat(array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(fn (i, j) => std (2 random(1.0) - 1)))
   368	
   369	run(): () = do
   370	  (d, nh, vocab, block) = (16, 4, 27, 16)
   371	  layer = Layer(nh, randomMat(d, d, 0.08), randomMat(d, d, 0.08), randomMat(d, d, 0.08),
   372	                randomMat(d, d, 0.08), randomMat(4 d, d, 0.08), randomMat(d, 4 d, 0.08))
   373	  model = Model(randomMat(vocab, d, 0.08), randomMat(block, d, 0.08), randomMat(vocab, d, 0.08), <| layer |>)
   374	  tokens = <|[\ZZ32\] 26, 4, 12, 12, 0, 26 |>
   375	  recordTime(0)
   376	  L = loss(model, tokens)
   377	  println("loss: " L.v "  (ln 27 = " (log 27.0) ")  nodes: " nodeCount)
   378	  printTime(0)
   379	  recordTime(1)
   380	  backward(L)
   381	  printTime(1)
   382	  (* finite differences on three parameter entries *)
   383	  h = 1.0/1048576.0
   384	  f(): RR64 = loss(model, tokens).v
   385	  worst: RR64 := 0.0
   386	  for (W, i, j) <- seq(<|[\(Mat, ZZ32, ZZ32)\] (model.E, 26, 3), (layer.W_q, 5, 7), (layer.W_out, 2, 40) |>) do
   387	    a = W.grad.v[i, j]
   388	    W.v[i, j] := W.v[i, j] + h; fp = f(); W.v[i, j] := W.v[i, j] - 2 h; fm = f(); W.v[i, j] := W.v[i, j] + h
   389	    fd = (fp - fm)/(2 h)
   390	    println("  analytic " a "  finite difference " fd)
   391	    worst := worst MAX |a - fd|
   392	  end
   393	  println("max |analytic - finite difference| = " worst)
   394	end
   395	(* END TESTS *)
   396	end

# The `.out` files here were recovered from Run B's transcript

Run B ran every probe in this directory as `probes/run.sh NAME`, which tees the
interpreter's output — command line, output, `exit: N` — into `NAME.out` beside
the probe. Those files are what `../gaps.md`, `../article.md` and
`worker/REPORT.md` cite as evidence. None of them reached the branch: the
repository's root `.gitignore` ignores `*.out` (line 46, a LaTeX byproduct rule
that predates this directory by years), so every `git add explorations/run-b`
silently skipped them.

They were reconstructed afterwards from the session transcripts, by pairing each
`Bash` tool call that ran `probes/run.sh` with its recorded tool result:

- `run-b.jsonl` — the main session (the `c*` and `s*` probes)
- `run-b-subagents/agent-a3425313e0fb75a35.jsonl` — the independent worker
  (`worker/w*`)

**115 outputs recovered, covering all 76 probe sources; nothing cited is
missing.** Every `.fss` in this directory and in `worker/` has at least one run
in the transcripts, and every `.out` filename cited in `../gaps.md`,
`../article.md` and `worker/REPORT.md` now exists.

Each file carries a one-line `[recovered from the transcript, ...]` footer
naming the transcript and line it came from and how faithful it is. **41 files
are the complete output** `run.sh` wrote (the worker displayed its runs whole).
**74 are partial**, because the session displayed the run through a filter — the
tee had already written the full file to disk, but only the filtered view
survives in the transcript.

No tool result was cut by the harness itself: no "output truncated" marker
appears anywhere in either transcript. Every loss below is the session's own
`| tail -N`, `| head -N` or `| grep -v` on the display side.

## Probes run more than once

`run.sh` overwrites `NAME.out`, so a re-run destroyed the previous file. Where
Run B itself preserved the earlier output under a name (`cp NAME.out
NAME.first.out`, `cp w03_dotpostfix.out w03_dotpostfix.attempt1.out`, ...) that
name is reproduced, because the write-ups cite it. Earlier runs Run B did not
name are written as `NAME.run1.out`, `NAME.run2.out` in order; these are runs
that never existed as files in Run B's own tree.

| probe | runs | transcript line -> file |
|---|---|---|
| `c03_closures` | 3 | 235 -> `c03_closures.run1.out` · 261 -> `c03_closures.run2.out` · 281 -> `c03_closures.out` |
| `c04_gradmap` | 2 | 237 -> `c04_gradmap.run1.out` · 263 -> `c04_gradmap.out` |
| `c05_rowwise` | 2 | 239 -> `c05_rowwise.run1.out` · 264 -> `c05_rowwise.out` |
| `c06_value_object` | 2 | 241 -> `c06_value_object.run1.out` · 282 -> `c06_value_object.out` |
| `c07_contracts_tests` | 2 | 243 -> `c07_contracts_tests.property.out` · 266 -> `c07_contracts_tests.out` |
| `c13_sum_protocol` | 2 | 408 -> `c13_sum_protocol.first.out` · 432 -> `c13_sum_protocol.out` |
| `c14_lazy_grad_generators` | 3 | 410 -> `.run1.out` · 422 -> `.run2.out` · 430 -> `c14_lazy_grad_generators.out` |

Two files the worker itself deleted (`worker/w02_paste.attempt1.out` and
`worker/w11_arraylit.attempt1.out`, both at the point where it tidied up) are
not recreated; each was a byte-for-byte copy of a `.out` that survives.

## Partial outputs

**Start missing** — the session showed only `| tail -N`, and no later command
displayed the head of the file, so the `$ FORTRESS_THREADS=...` command line and
the first output lines are gone: `c01_library_matrix.out`,
`c02c_pasting_runtime.out`, `c02d_pasting_typed.out`, `c04_gradmap.out`,
`c04_gradmap.run1.out`, `c16_model_spellings.out`, `s01_tape.out`,
`s01_tape.run4.out`, `s02_functional.out`.

**End missing** — the session showed only `| head -N`, so the stack tail and the
`exit:` line are gone: `c19_bigunion_collision.out`.

**Head and tail both known, middle missing** — the run was displayed as a tail,
and a later command displayed the head of the same file; the two views are
spliced and the hole between them is marked in the file with an explicit
`[... the middle of this run was never displayed in the transcript ...]` line:
`c02e_pasting_variants.out`, `c02f_silent_unbound.out`,
`c10_anyvector_dispatch.out`, `c13_sum_protocol.first.out`,
`c16_model_spellings.prefixmax.out`, `c17_bar_continuation.leading.out`,
`c18_map_of_shapes.out`, `c20b_field_transpose.out`,
`c20c_prefix_juxtaposition.out`, `s02_functional.run4.out`,
`s02_functional.run5.out`. (Five more files spliced with a clean overlap and
have no hole.)

**Filtered** — the worker displayed these through
`grep -v "^\tat \|^java.lang.Throwable\|Turn on"`, so the Java stack lines the
tee had written are absent; the error text and `exit:` line are intact:
`worker/w08_cat1.out`–`w08_cat6.out`, `worker/w16_shadow_field.out`,
`worker/w16_shadow_param.out`, `worker/w17_bigunion_sel.out`,
`worker/w17_bigunion_except.out`, `worker/w18_a.out`–`w18_g.out`.

The remaining 53 partial files were shown through a `tail -N` or `head -N` wide
enough to cover the whole run: they carry both the `$ FORTRESS_THREADS=...`
command line and the `exit:` line, so their content is whole — only the
provenance is second-hand, which is what their footer records.

## Nothing unrecoverable

No probe cited by `../gaps.md`, `../article.md` or `worker/REPORT.md` is without
a recovered output. Three commands in the main transcript that look like probe
runs did nothing at all — they ran in the wrong working directory and every
step failed with "No such file or directory" (`run-b.jsonl` lines 502, 597,
654); each was retried successfully a few turns later, and it is the retry that
is recorded here.

## Committing them

`explorations/run-b/.gitignore` now ends with `!probes/**/*.out`, which
un-ignores exactly these files against the root rule.

=== v2_rmsnorm ===
`rmsnorm(x: Vec): Vec = x/(SQRT((x DOT x)/(|x|) + epsilon))
rmsnorm(X: Mat): Mat = stack(<| rmsnorm(x) | x <- X |>)`
=== v2_softmax ===
`softmax(z: Vec): Vec = do
  e = exp(z - (BIG MAX[z_i <- z] z_i))
  e/(SUM e)
end
softmax(Z: Mat): Mat = stack(<| softmax(z) | z <- Z |>)`
=== v2_attention ===
`(* causal mask: a position attends to itself and the positions before it *)
mask(n: ZZ32): Mat = mat(array[\RR64\](n, n).fill(fn (i, j) => if j > i then -infinity else 0.0 end))

attend(Q: Mat, K: Mat, V: Mat): Mat = do
  d_k = cols(Q)
  softmax((Q K^T)/(SQRT d_k) + mask(|Q|)) V
end`
=== v2_layer ===
`object Layer(n_head: ZZ32, W_q: Mat, W_k: Mat, W_v: Mat, W_o: Mat, W_in: Mat, W_out: Mat)
  attention(X: Mat): Mat = do
    (Q, K, V) = (X W_q^T, X W_k^T, X W_v^T)
    d_h = cols(Q) DIV n_head
    head(h: ZZ32): Mat = do c = (h d_h) # d_h; attend(Q[:, c], K[:, c], V[:, c]) end
    concat(<| head(h) | h <- 0#n_head |>) W_o^T
  end
  mlp(X: Mat): Mat = relu(X W_in^T) W_out^T
  forward(X: Mat): Mat = do
    X' = X + attention(rmsnorm(X))
    X' + mlp(rmsnorm(X'))
  end
  matrices(): List[\Mat\] = <| W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, W_in, W_out |>
end`
=== v2_model ===
`object Model(E: Mat, P: Mat, W_lm: Mat, layers: List[\Layer\])
  (* logits for the next token at every position *)
  forward(tokens: List[\ZZ32\]): Mat = do
    var X: Mat := rmsnorm(E[tokens] + P[0 # |tokens|])
    for l <- seq(layers) do X := l.forward(X) end
    X W_lm^T
  end
  matrices(): List[\Mat\] = <| E, P, W_lm |> || (BIG CONCAT[\Mat\][l <- layers] l.matrices())
end`
=== v2_loss ===
`(* cross-entropy of the next token, averaged over the positions *)
loss(model: Model, tokens: List[\ZZ32\]): Num = do
  n = |tokens| - 1
  (x, y) = (tokens[0 # n], tokens[1 # n])
  P = softmax(model.forward(x))
  -(1/n) (SUM[t <- 0#n] log P[t, y[t]])
end`
=== v2_adam ===
`object Adam(beta1: RR64, beta2: RR64, epsilon: RR64)
  (* one update of the parameters theta from their gradient g, with the moment
     estimates m and v, at step t with learning rate eta: Kingma & Ba, Algorithm 1 *)
  step(theta: Params, g: Params, m: Params, v: Params, t: ZZ32, eta: RR64): (Params, Params, Params) = do
    m' = beta1 m + (1 - beta1) g
    v' = beta2 v + (1 - beta2) (g ODOT g)
    m_hat = m'/(1 - beta1^t)
    v_hat = v'/(1 - beta2^t)
    (theta - eta m_hat/(SQRT v_hat + epsilon), m', v')
  end
end`
=== v2_sample ===
`(* inverse-transform sampling with the uniform draw u: the number of prefix sums
   of p that do not exceed u times the total (random.choices normalizes), capped at
   the last index *)
pick(p: Vec, u: RR64): ZZ32 = do
  total = SUM[p_i <- p] p_i
  cumulative(j: ZZ32): RR64 = SUM[i <- 0:j] p[i]
  (|<| j | j <- p.indices, cumulative(j) <= u total |>|) MIN (|p| - 1)
end`

`opr juxtaposition(A: Mat, B: Mat): Mat = mat(A.v B.v, fn G => do A.grad += G B^T; B.grad += A^T G end, A, B)
opr (A: Mat)^T: Mat = mat(A.v.t(), fn G => A.grad += G^T, A)
opr +(A: Mat, B: Mat): Mat = mat(A.v + B.v, fn G => do A.grad += G; B.grad += G end, A, B)
opr ODOT(A: Mat, B: Mat): Mat = mat(hadamard(A.v, B.v), fn G => do A.grad += G ODOT B; B.grad += G ODOT A end, A, B)
opr /(A: Mat, c: RR64): Mat = mat(A.v.scale(1/c), fn G => A.grad += G/c, A)
relu(X: Mat): Mat = mat(X.v.map[\RR64\](fn e => e MAX 0.0), fn G => X.grad += G ODOT positive(X), X)
positive(X: Mat): Mat = mat(X.v.map[\RR64\](fn e => if e > 0.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end))
cols(X: Mat, j0: ZZ32, w: ZZ32): Mat =
  mat(X.v[(0, j0) # (rows(X), w)].copy(), fn G => X.grad += colsInto(G, j0, w, cols(X)), X)
(* rows stacked into a matrix; each row's adjoint is the matching row of G *)
stack(xs: List[\Vec\]): Mat =
  Mat(array[\RR64\](|xs|, |xs[0]|).fill(fn (t, j) => (xs[t]).v[j]), <|[\Node\] x | x <- xs |>,
      fn G => for (t, x) <- xs.indexValuePairs do x.grad += G[t] end)
(* column-wise concatenation of the heads; each head's adjoint is its block of columns of G *)
concat(hs: List[\Mat\]): Mat = do
  w = cols(hs[0])
  Mat(array[\RR64\](rows(hs[0]), w |hs|).fill(fn (i, j) => (hs[j DIV w]).v[i, j MOD w]), <|[\Node\] H | H <- hs |>,
      fn G => for (h, H) <- hs.indexValuePairs do H.grad += cols(G, h w, w) end)
end`

`opr +(x: Vec, y: Vec): Vec = vec(x.v + y.v, fn g => do x.grad += g; y.grad += g end, x, y)
opr -(x: Vec, c: RR64): Vec = vec(x.v.map[\RR64\](fn e => e - c), fn g => x.grad += g, x)
opr ODOT(x: Vec, y: Vec): Vec = vec(x.v.pmul(y.v), fn g => do x.grad += g ODOT y; y.grad += g ODOT x end, x, y)
opr DOT(x: Vec, y: Vec): Num = num(x.v DOT y.v, fn g => do x.grad += g y; y.grad += g x end, x, y)
opr juxtaposition(c: Num, x: Vec): Vec = vec(c.v x.v, fn g => do c.grad += g DOT x; x.grad += c g end, c, x)
opr /(x: Vec, c: RR64): Vec = vec(x.v.scale(1/c), fn g => x.grad += g/c, x)
opr /(x: Vec, s: Num): Vec = vec(x.v.scale(1/s.v), fn g => do x.grad += g/s; s.grad += -((g DOT x)/(s s)) end, x, s)
exp(x: Vec): Vec = do e = x.v.map[\RR64\](fn t => exp t); vec(e, fn g => x.grad += g ODOT vec(e), x) end

opr -(a: Num, b: Num): Num = a + (-b)

opr /(a: Num, c: RR64): Num = (1/c) a
opr /(a: Num, n: ZZ32): Num = (1.0/n) a
opr SQRT(a: Num): Num = do s = SQRT a.v; num(s, fn g => a.grad += g/(2 s), a) end
log(a: Num): Num = num(log a.v, fn g => a.grad += g/a, a)`

`(* Sigma over anything that has a +: scalars, numbers, nodes.  The library's
   own SUM is sealed to Number, so it is hidden by the except-import above and
   redeclared once, over a reduction whose join dispatches on its arguments. *)
object PlusReduction extends CommutativeMonoidReduction[\Any\]
  getter asString(): String = "PlusReduction"
  empty(): Any = 0
  join(a: Any, b: Any): Any = a + b
end
opr SUM(): BigReduction[\Any, Any\] = BigReduction[\Any, Any\](PlusReduction)`
=== v2_backward ===
`(* every node after all the nodes it depends on *)
topo(root: Node): List[\Node\] = do
  var seen: Set[\ZZ32\] := {[\ZZ32\] }
  var order: List[\Node\] := <|[\Node\] |>
  visit(n: Node): () =
    if n.id NOTIN seen then
      seen := seen.add(n.id)
      for c <- seq(n.children) do visit(c) end
      order := order.addRight(n)
    end
  visit(root)
  order
end
backward(L: Num): () = do
  L.grad := num(1.0)
  for n <- seq(topo(L).reverse) do n.push() end
end`
=== v2_carriers ===
`object Num(v: RR64, children: List[\Node\], backprop: Num -> ()) extends Node
  id: ZZ32 = nextId()
  var adj: Maybe[\Num\] := Nothing[\Num\]
  getter grad(): Num = if x <- adj then x else num(0.0) end
  setter grad(x: Num): () = adj := Just[\Num\](x)
  push(): () = backprop(self.grad)
end

object Vec(v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], children: List[\Node\], backprop: Vec -> ())
    extends { Node, ZeroIndexed[\RR64\], DelegatedIndexed[\RR64, ZZ32\] }
  id: ZZ32 = nextId()
  var adj: Maybe[\Vec\] := Nothing[\Vec\]
  getter grad(): Vec = if x <- adj then x else vec(zeros(|v|)) end
  setter grad(x: Vec): () = adj := Just[\Vec\](x)
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0 # |v|
  push(): () = backprop(self.grad)
  opr |self|: ZZ32 = |v|
  opr [i: ZZ32]: RR64 = v[i]
end

object Mat(v: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], children: List[\Node\], backprop: Mat -> ())
    extends { Node, Generator[\Vec\] }
  id: ZZ32 = nextId()
  var adj: Maybe[\Mat\] := Nothing[\Mat\]
  getter grad(): Mat = if x <- adj then x else mat(zeros(rows(self), cols(self))) end
  setter grad(x: Mat): () = adj := Just[\Mat\](x)
  push(): () = backprop(self.grad)
  opr |self|: ZZ32 = rows(self)                  (* the number of rows: positions *)
  (* the rows, as nodes, are what a matrix generates (x drawn from X) *)
  generate[\R\](r: Reduction[\R\], body: Vec -> R): R =
    (0 # rows(self)).generate[\R\](r, fn t => body(self[t]))
  (* row t as a node; its adjoint is scattered back into row t *)
  opr [t: ZZ32]: Vec = vec(v[t, :].copy(), fn g => self.grad += rowInto(g, t, rows(self), cols(self)), self)
  (* element (t, j) as a scalar node *)
  opr [t: ZZ32, j: ZZ32]: Num = num(v[t, j], fn g => self.grad += entryInto(g, t, j, rows(self), cols(self)), self)
  (* the rows named by a sequence of indices, as a matrix: E[tokens], P[0#n] *)
  opr [ts: Generator[\ZZ32\]]: Mat = do
    ix = <|[\ZZ32\] t | t <- ts |>
    mat(array[\RR64\](|ix|, cols(self)).fill(fn (i, j) => v[ix[i], j]),
        fn G => self.grad += scatter(G, ix, rows(self)), self)
  end
  (* the columns c, as a matrix: Q[:, c] *)
  opr [_: TrivialOpenRange, c: Range[\ZZ32\]]: Mat = cols(self, c.lower, |c|)
end`
=== v2_factories ===
`(* constants (no children) and nodes (a backward map, then the children) *)
num(a: RR64): Num = Num(a, <|[\Node\] |>, fn g => ())
vec(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Vec = Vec(a, <|[\Node\] |>, fn g => ())
mat(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Mat = Mat(a, <|[\Node\] |>, fn G => ())
num(a: RR64, f: Num -> (), cs: Node...): Num = Num(a, <|[\Node\] c | c <- cs |>, f)
vec(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], f: Vec -> (), cs: Node...): Vec = Vec(a, <|[\Node\] c | c <- cs |>, f)
mat(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], f: Mat -> (), cs: Node...): Mat = Mat(a, <|[\Node\] c | c <- cs |>, f)`
=== v2_params ===
`(* the parameters as Karpathy's state_dict: a name for every matrix; the
   elementwise algebra Adam needs is defined once, over the whole record *)
object Params(m: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\])
  opr [name: String]: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = m[name]
  each(f: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Params = record(fn name => f(m[name]), dom(m))
  zip(o: Params, f: (Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]) -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Params =
    record(fn name => f(m[name], o[name]), dom(m))
end
(* a record from a function of the name, by a fold: the map comprehension
   cannot join matrices of different shapes (probes/c18), and BIG UNION over
   singleton maps collides with Set's BIG UNION in one component (probes/c19) *)
record(f: String -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], keys: Generator[\String\]): Params = do
  var r: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] := {[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] }
  for name <- seq(keys) do r := r.add(name, f(name)) end
  Params(r)
end
opr +(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x + y)
opr -(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x - y)
opr juxtaposition(c: RR64, a: Params): Params = a.each(fn x => x.scale(c))
opr ODOT(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => hadamard(x, y))
opr /(a: Params, c: RR64): Params = a.each(fn x => x.scale(1/c))
opr /(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x.ivmap[\RR64\](fn (ij, e) => e/y.get(ij)))
opr +(a: Params, c: RR64): Params = a.each(fn x => x.map[\RR64\](fn e => e + c))
opr SQRT(a: Params): Params = a.each(fn x => x.map[\RR64\](fn e => SQRT e))`
=== v2_build ===
`(* the model's nodes for one step, built from the parameter record *)
build(theta: Params, n_head: ZZ32, n_layer: ZZ32): Model = do
  p(name: String): Mat = mat(theta[name])
  layer(l: ZZ32): Layer = do
    w(part: String): Mat = p("layer" l "." part)
    Layer(n_head, w("attn_wq"), w("attn_wk"), w("attn_wv"), w("attn_wo"), w("mlp_fc1"), w("mlp_fc2"))
  end
  Model(p("wte"), p("wpe"), p("lm_head"), <| layer(l) | l <- 0#n_layer |>)
end
(* the names, in the order of Model.matrices() *)
names(n_layer: ZZ32): List[\String\] =
  (<|[\String\] "wte", "wpe", "lm_head" |> ||
   (BIG CONCAT[\String\][l <- 0#n_layer] <|[\String\] "layer" l ".attn_wq", "layer" l ".attn_wk", "layer" l ".attn_wv",
                                                      "layer" l ".attn_wo", "layer" l ".mlp_fc1", "layer" l ".mlp_fc2" |>))
(* the gradient record after backward *)
grads(g: Model, n_layer: ZZ32): Params = do
  var r: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] := {[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] }
  for (i, name) <- seq((names(n_layer)).indexValuePairs) do r := r.add(name, ((g.matrices())[i]).grad.v) end
  Params(r)
end`
=== v2_init ===
`(* Gaussian initialization (Box-Muller over the library's uniform random) *)
gauss(std: RR64): RR64 = do
  (u1, u2) = (random(1.0) MAX 10.0^(-12), random(1.0))
  std (SQRT(-2 (log u1))) (cos(2 pi u2))
end
init(vocab: ZZ32, d: ZZ32, block: ZZ32, n_layer: ZZ32, std: RR64): Params = do
  shape(name: String): (ZZ32, ZZ32) = case name of
    "wte" => (vocab, d); "wpe" => (block, d); "lm_head" => (vocab, d)
    else => if name.endsWith("mlp_fc1") then (4 d, d) elif name.endsWith("mlp_fc2") then (d, 4 d) else (d, d) end
  end
  record(fn name => do (n, m) = shape(name); array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(fn (i, j) => gauss(std)) end, names(n_layer))
end`

`object Tokenizer(uchars: String)
  bos: ZZ32 = |uchars|
  encode(doc: String): List[\ZZ32\] =

  decode(t: ZZ32): String = "" || uchars[t]
end`

 'rmsnorm': r"\mathrm{rmsnorm}(x)=\frac{x}{\sqrt{\frac{1}{d}\sum_{i=1}^{d} x_i^{2}+\varepsilon}} = \frac{x}{\sqrt{\frac{x\cdot x}{d}+\varepsilon}}\qquad(\varepsilon=10^{-5})",
 'softmax': r"\mathrm{softmax}(z)_i=\frac{e^{z_i-m}}{\sum_j e^{z_j-m}},\qquad m=\max_j z_j",
 'attention': r"\mathrm{Attention}(Q,K,V)=\mathrm{softmax}\!\left(\frac{QK^{\top}}{\sqrt{d_k}}+M\right)V,\qquad M_{ij}=\begin{cases}0 & j\le i\\ -\infty & j>i\end{cases}",
 'multihead': r"\begin{aligned} Q&=XW_q^{\top},\quad K=XW_k^{\top},\quad V=XW_v^{\top},\qquad c_h = \{h\,d_h,\ldots,(h+1)d_h-1\}\\ \mathrm{head}_h&=\mathrm{Attention}(Q_{:,c_h},K_{:,c_h},V_{:,c_h})\\ \mathrm{MHA}(X)&=\mathrm{Concat}(\mathrm{head}_1,\ldots,\mathrm{head}_H)\,W_o^{\top}\end{aligned}",

#!/bin/bash
# Render a LaTeX display-math snippet to figures/NAME.svg with the same TeX and
# dvisvgm pipeline as the code figures, so the formula and the Fortress render
# are typeset at parity.  Usage: tools/mathfig.sh NAME 'latex math'
set -u
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$ROOT/figures"
NAME="$1"; MATH="$2"
cat > "$NAME.tex" <<TEX
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage[active,tightpage]{preview}
\setlength\PreviewBorder{6pt}
\begin{document}
\begin{preview}
\mbox{\$\displaystyle $MATH\$}
\end{preview}
\end{document}
TEX
latex -interaction=nonstopmode "$NAME.tex" > "$NAME.latex.out" 2>&1; st=$?
if [ $st -ne 0 ]; then grep -A4 '^!' "$NAME.latex.out" | head -20; fi
dvisvgm --no-fonts --exact-bbox -o "$NAME.svg" "$NAME.dvi" > /dev/null 2>&1
rm -f "$NAME.tex" "$NAME.dvi" "$NAME.aux" "$NAME.log" "$NAME.latex.out"
echo "math $NAME exit: $st $(stat -c %s "$NAME.svg" 2>/dev/null)"

# Mechanism inventory (quality gate 2)

One pass over the specification's table of contents (`Specification/fortress/fortress.tex`
and the chapters it inputs; the built `.toc` is not in the tree, so the list was
derived from the `\chapter`/`\section` commands of the TeX sources). For each
mechanism: where it is specified, whether this run's design uses it, and if not,
why -- decided against this list, not against what came to mind first. Marks:
USED · CONSIDERED (tried or weighed, not adopted, reason given) · UNAVAILABLE
(the tree does not implement it; ledger row or probe cited) · N/A (no bearing on
this program). The un-mainstream mechanisms are flagged ★.

| # | mechanism | spec | mark | this run |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | components and APIs, `import ... except` ★ | basic/components/source-code.tex | USED | `import FortressLibrary.{...} except { opr BIG + }` frees Σ for a user reduction (ledger row 41). A separate API for the core was CONSIDERED and not built: the check driver needs the parameter nodes' `grad` fields and every operator; the composed component (tools/build.py) keeps the core free of plumbing (the blinded run's route; ledger row 83 is not involved). |
| 2 | cross-component overloading ★ | basic/components/source-code.tex | N/A | one component per run. |
| 3 | where-clauses ★ | basic/trait-parameters.tex, Where Clauses | UNAVAILABLE for covariance (ledger row 17); not needed here. |
| 4 | functional methods ★ | basic/functions.tex; ledger rows 30-32 | USED | `dom(m)`, and every carrier operator is a top-level `opr` visible in this component; the library-visible `+` on the carriers (needed by the `Any` reduction's `join`) works because dispatch is on the dynamic types (ledger rows 30-31 govern *library generic code* calling a user `opr`; the reduction here is the user's own object, not the library's). |
| 5 | coercion ★ | basic/conversions-coercions.tex | UNAVAILABLE (ledger row 19) | would remove the `num`/`vec`/`mat` lifts of constants and the `(child, map)` plumbing; noted in the departures table. |
| 6 | `value` objects ★ | basic/objects.tex, Value Objects | CONSIDERED | accepted by the interpreter (probes/c06, `===` compares fields); the graph nodes cannot be value objects because reverse mode accumulates adjoints per node (a `var`), and the array values they hold are the library's mutable arrays. The parameter record `Params` and the scalar/vector/matrix *values* are immutable in use. |
| 7 | `comprises` sealing ★ | basic/traits.tex:231-235 | CONSIDERED | not needed: the three carriers are unrelated objects; `Node` is open. |
| 8 | dimensions and units ★ | basic/dimensions.tex; advanced/defining-dimensions.tex | UNAVAILABLE (ledger row 26) | a `dim` for probabilities or embedding width was the one use; N/A. |

Parallelism is not suppressed to match Python — `seq(` appears seven times in the core (`src/MicroGPT.fss:102, 182, 190, 245, 281, 326, 386`), each at a true dependency or an accumulation into a mutable map, and the four-thread check gives the same 54 verdicts. Renders are of actual source (§3). No fixture constant or verification plumbing sits in the core: the goldens live in `MicroGPTData`, the comparisons in `src/check_main.part`, and `tools/build.py` strips the test region; the only global in the core is `nodeCount`/`nextId()`, which `topo` needs. No self-praise: a scan of `article.md`, `README.md`, `gaps.md` and `mechanisms.md` for the usual words returns nothing. No model name appears in any file the run itself committed — the one occurrence under `explorations/run-b/` is the header comment of `probes/REPORT-worker.md`, which the coordinator added afterwards in `4bb9e7a2a`.
- **The brief's mission clause the run only half serves.** It asks that, for each rendered pair, the spelling be derived from the formula first and then compared with the prior runs', "and where you land on their spelling, say what else you considered and why it lost". §4.7 does this for six pairs, and the exploration sheets `figures/x00`–`x02` hold the candidate spellings — but only `x02_variants` covers rmsnorm, softmax and the loss, and the departures table records what remains rather than what was rejected. For the layer, Adam and sampling, the article compares against the prior runs without naming a spelling it tried and discarded.

## 7. Lines, reproduced with the run's own instrument

`tools/linecount.py` on the same files gives 148 for the pinned Python, 156 for the blinded run's core, 248 for Astra's, 258 for the open run's, 97 and 44 for the two drivers — all matching article §6.4 — and **236 for `src/MicroGPT.fss --core`, where the article says 237** (its own breakdown, engine 103 + model 40 + training 67 + helpers 27, sums to 237). One line, in the same family as the 307-against-305 node count and the 53-against-54 check count.

## 8. What the run got right that the tree did not have before, and the faults that matter

Before this run the tree had three verified scalar microGPTs and a report saying matrix-level autodiff was possible on the interpreter; it now has a working one whose engine is 103 lines and whose backward maps are written in the forward algebra — `fn G => do A.grad += G B^T; B.grad += A^T G end` in `src/MicroGPT.fss:141` is the matrix-calculus table typeset as itself — and which reproduces the pinned reference over two steps, every gradient, every Adam-updated parameter and three replayed samples to 4.4·10⁻¹⁶ at one thread and at four, in 12,813 nodes against the scalar design's 1,393,152 (`checks/check_run_output.txt`, reproduced as `run-b-review-probes/r01_check_threads1.out` and `r02_check_threads4.out`). Three things beyond the program will outlive it: the lazily allocated `Maybe` adjoint with a getter that returns a fresh zero (`src/MicroGPT.fss:33-36`), which is what lets an adjoint be a carrier at all and is the mechanism the whole notation stands on; the measured refutation of functional backprop on a shared graph, priced rather than argued (`probes/s03_functional_depth.fss`, 6,950 ms against 198 ms at depth 10); and `mechanisms.md`, the first inventory in this tree of what the specification offers checked row by row against what the implementation gives.

The faults that matter are three, and none of them is in the program. First, the evidence base is second-hand: `probes/RECOVERED-OUTPUTS.md` records that all 115 probe outputs were reconstructed from transcripts after the fact, 74 of them partial, and among the partial ones are the sole reproducers the article cites for rows the notation depends on (`probes/c16_model_spellings.prefixmax.out` for row 88), while rows 85 and 92 cite a transcript that is not in this tree at all — so quality gate 3 holds in form and not in fact, and a reader must re-probe, as I did, to close it. Second, the article's own numbers drift from its own artefacts in four places — 237 lines against the 236 its `tools/linecount.py` prints, 307 smoke-test nodes against the 305 in `checks/smoke_output.txt`, 53 named checks against the 54 in `checks/check_run_output.txt`, and a Reproduce block advertising 46 s and 75 s where its shipped logs say 64 s and 113 s — small individually, but they are the numbers a reader would check first. Third, the by-eye standard is applied unevenly at the edges: `figures/v2_scalars.svg` sets `opr SQRT(a: Num)` with the radical drawn over the parameter's type ascription, a typesetter fault of exactly the kind §7.2 exists to record, and it has no row there.
